newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian market firms, led by Hansapank.
newsitem.headline: Estonian market firms, led by Hansapank.

text.p: Leading bank Hansapank was at the centre of market attention on Wednesday as it strengthened further and helped shares as a whole to gain, dealers said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index gained 0.87 percent to 194.37 on turnover of 45.9 million kroons on the official list.
Dealers said that buying in Helsinki helped Hansapank to end at 194 kroons, up from 190.05 kroons. In Helsinki, it gained 1.50 markka to 72.50 markka on volume of 5,000.
Hansapank, the largest bank in Estonia, dominated trade with turnover of 22.9 million kroons.
One Helsinki-based broker said the rise in Hansapank was caused by interest from large eastern investment funds.
Another dealer said small Finnish investors had had their interest sparked after a TV programme on Baltic banks, which said that Hansapank was one of the best.
Estonian players were cautious over Hansapank's rise.
"It is never good news when a stock suddenly rises in price but the market volume and other stocks have moved with it, so there may be support for this new price," said one dealer.
However another trader noted that the price rise was from far from a smooth trend.
"There was a desire by some traders to keep the price higher and at one time it reached 195 kroons. It fell to 189 kroons later and then came back up to 194 kroons," said another trader.
Forekspank also nudged higher registering trade of 8.9 million kroons to close 1.37 kroons higher at 146.74 kroons.
Savings Bank fell by 2.05 kroons to 90.95 on turnover of six million kroons.
Tallinna pank continued to creep up. It ended trade 0.85 kroons higher on 60.50 kroons as it traded 4.9 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market was quieter with a volume of only 5.8 million kroons.
EMV construction company traded most stocks registering business of 1.7 million kroons and remained stable at 1,300 kroons.
Kalev confectionery saw trade of 1.5 million kroons and fell 25 kroons to 1,250 kroons.
